datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: IPC classification data were collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular monthly schedule across Mali in 2012. The classifications represent acute food insecurity phases mapped to geographic administrative units, providing temporal snapshots of food security conditions at four time points (January, April, July, October).
